verses.original: גַּם־ הַ֭יּוֹם מְרִ֣י שִׂחִ֑י יָ֝דִ֗י כָּבְדָ֥ה עַל־ אַנְחָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: gam- hay·yō·wm mə·rî śi·ḥî yā·ḏî kā·ḇə·ḏāh ‘al- ’an·ḥā·ṯî
verses.literal: Even today my complaint is bitter His hand is heavy despite my groaning

verses.original: מִֽי־ יִתֵּ֣ן יָ֭דַעְתִּי וְאֶמְצָאֵ֑הוּ אָ֝ב֗וֹא עַד־ תְּכוּנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: If only . . . I knew where to find Him so that I could go to His seat

verses.original: אֶעֶרְכָ֣ה לְפָנָ֣יו מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝פִ֗י אֲמַלֵּ֥א תוֹכָחֽוֹת׃
verses.literal: I would plead my case before Him and fill my mouth with arguments

verses.original: אֵ֭דְעָה מִלִּ֣ים יַעֲנֵ֑נִי וְ֝אָבִ֗ינָה מַה־ יֹּ֥אמַר לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ḏə·‘āh mil·lîm ya·‘ă·nê·nî wə·’ā·ḇî·nāh mah- yō·mar lî
verses.literal: I would learn how He would answer and consider what He would say

verses.original: הַבְּרָב־ כֹּ֭חַ יָרִ֣יב עִמָּדִ֑י לֹ֥א אַךְ־ ה֝֗וּא יָשִׂ֥ם בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hab·bə·rāḇ- kō·aḥ yā·rîḇ ‘im·mā·ḏî lō ’aḵ- hū yā·śim bî
verses.literal: Would He contend with me in His great power No He would certainly take note of me

verses.original: שָׁ֗ם יָ֭שָׁר נוֹכָ֣ח עִמּ֑וֹ וַאֲפַלְּטָ֥ה לָ֝נֶ֗צַח מִשֹּׁפְטִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: šām yā·šār nō·w·ḵāḥ ‘im·mōw wa·’ă·p̄al·lə·ṭāh lā·ne·ṣaḥ miš·šō·p̄ə·ṭî
verses.literal: Then an upright man could reason with Him and I would be delivered forever from my Judge

verses.original: הֵ֤ן קֶ֣דֶם אֶהֱלֹ֣ךְ וְאֵינֶ֑נּוּ וְ֝אָח֗וֹר וְֽלֹא־ אָבִ֥ין לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hên qe·ḏem ’e·hĕ·lōḵ wə·’ê·nen·nū wə·’ā·ḥō·wr wə·lō- ’ā·ḇîn lōw
verses.literal: If I go east He is not there and if I go west I cannot find Him

verses.original: שְׂמֹ֣אול בַּעֲשֹׂת֣וֹ וְלֹא־ אָ֑חַז יַעְטֹ֥ף יָ֝מִ֗ין וְלֹ֣א אֶרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: śə·mō·wl ba·‘ă·śō·ṯōw wə·lō- ’ā·ḥaz ya‘·ṭōp̄ yā·mîn wə·lō ’er·’eh
verses.literal: When He is at work in the north I cannot behold Him when He turns to the south I cannot see Him

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יָ֭דַע דֶּ֣רֶךְ עִמָּדִ֑י בְּ֝חָנַ֗נִי כַּזָּהָ֥ב אֵצֵֽא׃
verses.literal: Yet He knows the way I have taken . . . when He has tested me I will come forth as gold

verses.original: בַּ֭אֲשֻׁרוֹ אָחֲזָ֣ה רַגְלִ֑י דַּרְכּ֖וֹ שָׁמַ֣רְתִּי וְלֹא־ אָֽט׃
verses.literal: My feet have followed in His tracks I have kept His way without turning aside

verses.original: מִצְוַ֣ת שְׂ֭פָתָיו וְלֹ֣א אָמִ֑ישׁ מֵ֝חֻקִּ֗י צָפַ֥נְתִּי אִמְרֵי־ פִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: miṣ·waṯ śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw wə·lō ’ā·mîš mê·ḥuq·qî ṣā·p̄an·tî ’im·rê- p̄îw
verses.literal: I have not departed from the command of His lips I have treasured the words of His mouth more than my daily bread

verses.original: וְה֣וּא בְ֭אֶחָד וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶ֑נּוּ וְנַפְשׁ֖וֹ אִוְּתָ֣ה וַיָּֽעַשׂ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hū ḇə·’e·ḥāḏ ū·mî yə·šî·ḇen·nū wə·nap̄·šōw ’iw·wə·ṯāh way·yā·‘aś
verses.literal: But He is unchangeable . . . and who can oppose Him He does what He desires

verses.original: כִּ֭י יַשְׁלִ֣ים חֻקִּ֑י וְכָהֵ֖נָּה רַבּ֣וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: For He carries out His decree against me and He has many such plans

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּ֭ן מִפָּנָ֣יו אֶבָּהֵ֑ל אֶ֝תְבּוֹנֵ֗ן וְאֶפְחַ֥ד מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.literal: Therefore . . . I am terrified in His presence when I consider this I fear Him
God has made my heart faint the Almighty has terrified me

verses.original: כִּֽי־ לֹ֣א נִ֭צְמַתִּי מִפְּנֵי־ חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וּ֝מִפָּנַ֗י כִּסָּה־ אֹֽפֶל׃
verses.transliteration: kî- lō niṣ·mat·tî mip·pə·nê- ḥō·šeḵ ū·mip·pā·nay kis·sāh- ’ō·p̄el
verses.literal: Yet I am not silenced by the darkness by the thick darkness that covers my face
